I now have a comprehensive picture of all affected files. Let me compile the complete analysis.

---

## 1. Architecture Overview

The `Histogram` struct in `model/histogram/histogram.go` (Prometheus repo) is the **canonical native histogram representation** used throughout the entire Prometheus observability stack. It flows through the system as follows:

```
Scrape / OTLP Ingest
       │
       ▼
histogram.Histogram{...}  ← struct literal construction (BREAKS HERE)
       │
       ├─► WAL Encoding (tsdb/record/record.go)
       │         DecodeHistogram() fills &histogram.Histogram{}
       │
       ├─► Chunk Encoding (tsdb/chunkenc/histogram.go)
       │         AtHistogram() returns *histogram.Histogram
       │
       ├─► Remote Write Codec (prompb/codec.go, prompb/io/.../codec.go)
       │         ToIntHistogram() returns &histogram.Histogram{...}
       │
       ├─► OTLP Translator (storage/remote/otlptranslator/...)
       │         exponentialToNativeHistogram() returns &histogram.Histogram{...}
       │
       ▼
Thanos / Mimir / Tempo / OTel-Contrib
  consume via vendor copy of prometheus/model/histogram
       │
       ├─► Thanos: receive, compact/downsample, dedup, store
       ├─► Mimir: ingester, distributor, continuoustest, mimirpb
       ├─► Tempo: generator/registry
       └─► OTel-Contrib: prometheusremotewrite translator
```

Adding `CreatedTimestamp int64` as a new **required** (non-zero) field to `Histogram` breaks every **composite struct literal** of the form `histogram.Histogram{Field: val, ...}` that omits `CreatedTimestamp`. Go's compiler will reject these with `too few values in struct literal` (positional) or silently zero-initialize the field (named literals) — but since the field is semantically required, every construction site must be audited and updated.

---

## 2. Detailed Analysis

### Repository: `prometheus` (knowledgeId: `21712971-2584-493f-ab45-77a6b68c5e9f`)

**`model/histogram/histogram.go`** — The struct definition itself. The new field `CreatedTimestamp int64` must be added here between lines 50–80.

**`tsdb/tsdbutil/histogram.go`** — `GenerateTestHistogram(i int64)` (L41) and `GenerateTestCustomBucketsHistogram(i int64)` (L72) both construct `&histogram.Histogram{Count: ..., ZeroCount: ..., Schema: ..., ...}` named literals. Both must add `CreatedTimestamp`.

**`prompb/codec.go`** — `ToIntHistogram()` (L82) constructs `&histogram.Histogram{CounterResetHint: ..., Schema: ..., ZeroThreshold: ..., ZeroCount: ..., Count: ..., Sum: ..., PositiveSpans: ..., PositiveBuckets: ..., NegativeSpans: ..., NegativeBuckets: ..., CustomValues: ...}`. Must add `CreatedTimestamp`.

**`prompb/io/prometheus/write/v2/codec.go`** — `ToIntHistogram()` (L93) constructs an identical `&histogram.Histogram{...}` literal. Must add `CreatedTimestamp`.

**`tsdb/record/record.go`** — `HistogramSamples()` (L465) constructs `&histogram.Histogram{}` (empty literal, then fields set via `DecodeHistogram()`). The empty literal is safe, but `DecodeHistogram()` (L496) fills fields by assignment — `CreatedTimestamp` must be decoded/encoded in `EncodeHistogram` (L842) and `DecodeHistogram` (L496) to preserve WAL round-trip fidelity.

**`storage/remote/otlptranslator/prometheusremotewrite/histograms.go`** — `exponentialToNativeHistogram()` (L125) constructs `&histogram.Histogram{CounterResetHint: ..., Schema: ..., ZeroThreshold: ..., ZeroCount: ..., PositiveSpans: ..., PositiveBuckets: ..., NegativeSpans: ..., NegativeBuckets: ...}`. Must add `CreatedTimestamp`.

**`model/textparse/protobufparse.go`** — Parses protobuf metric families and constructs `histogram.Histogram` values during scrape ingestion. Must be updated.

**`tsdb/chunkenc/histogram.go`** — The `AtHistogram()` method on the chunk iterator returns a `*histogram.Histogram` by decoding from binary. The decode path must populate `CreatedTimestamp`.

**`web/api/testhelpers/fixtures.go`** — `FixtureHistogramSeries()` (L130) constructs `histogram.FloatHistogram{}` literals (not `Histogram`), so not directly broken, but the file imports the package and is part of the test surface.

**`tsdb/chunkenc/histogram_test.go`**, **`tsdb/chunkenc/float_histogram_test.go`**, **`model/histogram/convert_test.go`**, **`model/histogram/float_histogram_test.go`**, **`tsdb/record/record_test.go`**, **`promql/bench_test.go`**, **`storage/remote/otlptranslator/prometheusremotewrite/histograms_test.go`**, **`model/textparse/protobufparse_test.go`**, **`model/textparse/nhcbparse_test.go`** — All test files that construct `histogram.Histogram{}` literals in test cases.

---

### Repository: `thanos` (knowledgeId: `aa5426d0-10b2-4a9c-992a-5c0e9bc87c59`)

**`pkg/receive/writecapnp/write_request.go`** — `readHistogram()` (L147) constructs `h = &histogram.Histogram{CounterResetHint: ..., Count: ..., Sum: ..., Schema: ..., ZeroThreshold: ..., ZeroCount: ...}`. Must add `CreatedTimestamp`.

**`pkg/receive/otlptranslator/histograms.go`** — `exponentialToNativeHistogram()` constructs `prompb.Histogram{}` (Thanos's own protobuf type, not `histogram.Histogram` directly), so not directly broken at the struct literal level, but the downstream conversion via `pkg/store/storepb/prompb/custom.go` → `FromProtoHistogram()` → `HistogramProtoToFloatHistogram()` must propagate the new field.

**`pkg/store/storepb/prompb/custom.go`** — `FromProtoHistogram()` (L15) calls `FloatHistogramProtoToFloatHistogram` or `HistogramProtoToFloatHistogram`. These conversion functions must be updated to populate `CreatedTimestamp` from the proto message.

**`pkg/compact/downsample/downsample_test.go`** — Constructs `histogram.FloatHistogram{}` literals extensively (L54, L80, etc.) for test data. The integer `histogram.Histogram{}` is used indirectly via `tsdbutil.GenerateTestHistogram`. Must be updated if any `histogram.Histogram{}` literals are present.

**`pkg/testutil/testiters/iterators.go`** — `HistogramPair` struct holds `*histogram.Histogram`. The `AtHistogram()` method (L53) returns `it.l[it.i].H` — callers constructing `HistogramPair{T: ..., H: &histogram.Histogram{...}}` must add `CreatedTimestamp`.

**`pkg/dedup/iter_test.go`** — Imports `histogram` package; `sample.H()` returns `*histogram.Histogram` (panics). Indirect impact.

**`pkg/dedup/chunk_iter_test.go`** — Tests chunk series merging with histogram data; uses `tsdbutil.GenerateTestHistogram` indirectly.

**`pkg/store/storepb/testutil/series.go`** — Imports `histogram` package and constructs test series with histogram data. Must be updated.

**`test/e2e/native_histograms_test.go`** — End-to-end test constructing native histogram data; uses `histogram.Histogram` indirectly via helpers.

---

### Repository: `mimir` (knowledgeId: `0e6dcaca-9001-4c25-a0ff-8fe71b7ea205`)

**`pkg/continuoustest/util.go`** — `generatePosIntHistogram(value int64)` (L174) and `generateNegIntHistogram(value int64)` (L189) both construct `&histogram.Histogram{Sum: ..., Count: ..., ZeroThreshold: ..., Schema: ..., PositiveSpans: ..., PositiveBuckets: ...}`. **Direct breaks** — must add `CreatedTimestamp`.

**`pkg/mimirpb/custom.go`** — `ReduceResolution()` (L314), `reduceIntResolution()` (L346), `reduceFloatResolution()` (L336) operate on `mimirpb.Histogram` (Mimir's own protobuf type), not `histogram.Histogram` directly. However, the `reduceResolution` generic function (L362) uses `histogram.InternalBucketCount` interface from the prometheus package — indirect coupling.

**`pkg/mimirpb/query_response_extra.go`** — Uses unsafe pointer casting between Mimir and Prometheus histogram types (L127–133). If the struct layout changes (new field added), this **unsafe cast will silently corrupt data** and must be updated.

**`pkg/util/test/tsdb.go`** — `Sample` struct holds `Hist *histogram.Histogram` (L24). Callers constructing `Sample{Hist: &histogram.Histogram{...}}` must add `CreatedTimestamp`.

**`pkg/blockbuilder/tsdb_test.go`** — Constructs histogram test data; uses `tsdbutil.GenerateTestHistogram` and direct `histogram.Histogram{}` literals in test cases.

**`pkg/distributor/validate_test.go`** — Constructs `mimirpb.Histogram{}` literals (L1095–1198), not `histogram.Histogram{}` directly. Not broken at the struct literal level, but the validation logic that converts between the two types must be checked.

**`pkg/util/promtest/histogram.go`** — Validates native histogram format; reads `histogram.Histogram` fields. Must be updated if field access patterns change.

**`pkg/ingester/ingester_test.go`** — Large test file that constructs histogram data; uses `tsdbutil.GenerateTestHistogram` indirectly.

---

### Repository: `tempo` (knowledgeId: `1b0ae06b-32ba-4e1c-b75f-a7238d305255`)

**`modules/generator/registry/native_histogram.go`** — `nativeHistograms()` (L329) constructs:
```go
zeroHist := &promhistogram.Histogram{Schema: s.histogram.GetSchema()}
```
and (L339):
```go
hist := promhistogram.Histogram{Schema: ..., Count: ..., Sum: ..., ZeroThreshold: ..., ZeroCount: ...}
```
Both are **direct struct literal constructions** that will break. Must add `CreatedTimestamp`.

**`modules/generator/registry/appender_test.go`** — `capturingAppender` records `*histogram.Histogram` values. Indirect impact via test data construction.

---

### Repository: `opentelemetry-collector-contrib` (knowledgeId: `11013c10-9fdc-4638-8651-c1f2abb23c81`)

**`pkg/translator/prometheusremotewrite/histograms.go`** — `exponentialToNativeHistogram()` (L66) constructs `prompb.Histogram{}` (OTel's own `prompb` type, not `histogram.Histogram`). Not directly broken, but if this repo vendors `prometheus/model/histogram`, any vendored copy must be updated.

**`pkg/translator/prometheusremotewrite/histograms_v2.go`** — Same pattern as above.

**`pkg/translator/prometheusremotewrite/histograms_test.go`** — Constructs `prompb.Histogram{}` literals in test cases. Not directly broken.

**`pkg/translator/prometheusremotewrite/histograms_v2_test.go`** — Same.

**`receiver/prometheusreceiver/internal/transaction.go`** — `AppendHistogram()` receives `*histogram.Histogram` from the Prometheus scrape layer. If the vendored `histogram.Histogram` struct changes, this file must be recompiled against the new definition.

**`receiver/prometheusreceiver/internal/metricfamily_test.go`** — Constructs histogram test data; may contain `histogram.Histogram{}` literals.

---

SUMMARY: Adding a required CreatedTimestamp int64 field to the Histogram struct in prometheus/model/histogram will break all code that constructs Histogram literals without this new field. This change requires updates across the entire Prometheus ecosystem, including storage encoding, remote write codecs, OTLP translators, and downstream consumers like Thanos, Mimir, Tempo, and OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib.

FILES:
- prometheus/model/histogram/histogram.go — Source of truth for the Histogram struct definition; new field must be added here
- prometheus/tsdb/tsdbutil/histogram.go — GenerateTestHistogram() and GenerateTestCustomBucketsHistogram() construct Histogram literals that will break
- prometheus/prompb/codec.go — ToIntHistogram() constructs &histogram.Histogram{...} literal that must include CreatedTimestamp
- prometheus/prompb/io/prometheus/write/v2/codec.go — ToIntHistogram() constructs identical Histogram literal requiring the new field
- prometheus/tsdb/record/record.go — DecodeHistogram() and EncodeHistogram() must handle CreatedTimestamp for WAL round-trip fidelity
- prometheus/tsdb/chunkenc/histogram.go — AtHistogram() decodes Histogram from binary chunks; must populate CreatedTimestamp
- prometheus/storage/remote/otlptranslator/prometheusremotewrite/histograms.go — exponentialToNativeHistogram() constructs Histogram literal requiring CreatedTimestamp
- prometheus/model/textparse/protobufparse.go — Parses protobuf metric families and constructs Histogram values during scrape ingestion
- prometheus/model/textparse/nhcbparse.go — Wraps parser to convert classic histograms to native; constructs Histogram values
- prometheus/model/histogram/test_utils.go — GenerateBigTestHistograms() factory constructs Histogram literals that will break
- thanos/pkg/receive/writecapnp/write_request.go — readHistogram() constructs &histogram.Histogram{...} literal requiring CreatedTimestamp
- thanos/pkg/store/storepb/prompb/custom.go — FromProtoHistogram() converts protobuf to Histogram; must propagate CreatedTimestamp
- thanos/pkg/testutil/testiters/iterators.go — HistogramPair.AtHistogram() returns *histogram.Histogram; callers must add CreatedTimestamp
- thanos/pkg/store/storepb/testutil/series.go — Constructs test series with histogram data; must be updated
- mimir/pkg/continuoustest/util.go — generatePosIntHistogram() and generateNegIntHistogram() construct Histogram literals requiring CreatedTimestamp
- mimir/pkg/mimirpb/query_response_extra.go — Uses unsafe pointer casting between Mimir and Prometheus histogram types; will corrupt data if struct layout changes
- mimir/pkg/util/test/tsdb.go — Sample struct holds Hist *histogram.Histogram; callers must add CreatedTimestamp
- mimir/pkg/blockbuilder/tsdb_test.go — Constructs histogram test data; uses GenerateTestHistogram and direct Histogram literals
- tempo/modules/generator/registry/native_histogram.go — nativeHistograms() constructs &promhistogram.Histogram{...} literals requiring CreatedTimestamp
- opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/prometheusreceiver/internal/transaction.go — AppendHistogram() receives *histogram.Histogram; must be recompiled against new struct definition
